invalid_ohlc.unresolved_witness: 10 of 306 invalid rows have an instruments row and 0 of those have a daily_prices row on the same day; the rest have no independent witness in this Seed

method: Anomaly detection is row-level and rule-based; the category is chosen from the measured root cause, not from the anomaly kind.
Every event carries the raw values that triggered it in the evidence column of the CSV; the tracked counts hold aggregates only, no raw rows.
A branch set that explains nothing is UNEXPLAINED / UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_GAP and fails the build; the measured count is zero in this Seed.
notes: 3 of the 13 categories are used (CALENDAR_GAP, INVALID_SOURCE_RECORD, PRICE_BASIS_DIFFERENCE). The ten zero categories are zero for a stated reason, not by omission: SOURCE_MISMATCH and SOURCE_REVISION need two sources for one row, and price_history keeps exactly one row per (symbol, date) with a writer tag, not a source pair; CORPORATE_ACTION_MISSING, EVENT_DATE_MISMATCH and EVENT_RATIO_MISMATCH are event-chain findings owned by B5/B6 and cannot be read from a bare candle; SYMBOL_IDENTITY_MISMATCH is B7's identity join; MISSING_HISTORY is the absence of rows, which is B7's gap count, not a row event; PRECISION_OR_ROUNDING needs a rounding divergence, and every compared price here is bit-equal or clearly different, so no row required it; VERIFIED_NO_EVENT is a verification claim, which this stage does not make; UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_GAP is zero because every event got a cause from the row or the session evidence.

All 306 invalid OHLC rows carry legacy-unknown (306 rows); 10 of them resolve to an instruments row and 0 of those have a daily_prices row on the same day, so the root cause is the row's own field set and not a repair candidate.

Zero volume: 2692 rows, all legacy-unknown (2692). 194 of them sit on the 7 dates where no row of the DB traded at all (a date-level session evidence, not a per-symbol guess); the rest are flat bars whose close was carried (2357) or changed with no volume (135), plus 4 first bars and 2 non-flat bars.

The brief's sketch seeded the first bar of a symbol with its own close and passed a single prev_close per symbol to every row; both would manufacture false OPEN_EQ_PREV_CLOSE rows. This stage uses the preceding bar of the same symbol and measures 55224 equalities over 505036 comparable rows.
The 6,328 'reported no evidence' symbols are B9's inventory reconciliation and are not touched here.

open_eq_prev_close.method: previous close is the preceding bar of the same symbol in date order; the first bar of a symbol is never compared with itself

instrument_state.halt_attribution: not possible: zero overlap between the state snapshots and zero-volume rows

zero_volume.method: date-level session evidence (no row traded all day) then bar shape: flat/carried, flat/changed, non-flat
